programmes.d: A wreathmaker slips on ice and injures her arm which puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy until a selfless neighbor steps up to keep her business afloat.
Opposites attract when hometown girl Kristen meets L.A. lawyer Ryan Roarke, but in a case of mistaken identity, this pair is in for quite a romantic rollercoaster.

Christmas in the English countryside wasn't in Emma's plans until her sister, Amy, plans her wedding for Christmas eve. Dylan, Amy's co-Christmas market owner, teams up with Emma to bring order to the whirlwind wedding.
A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.
